tips_en: Read CoworkOS first for the broadest framework: its separation of strategic reasoning from persistent, human-supervised execution offers useful context for the more specialized training and perception methods in the other papers. CUA-Master and Reviso are complementary follow-ups, showing how recursive task generation and reinforcement learning can strengthen GUI agents and how learned active visual inspection can improve video understanding.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 CoworkOS，因为它提供了最完整的智能体系统视角，尤其适合理解策略推理、持久化执行与人类协作的分离。CUA-Master 与 Reviso 可作为后续阅读：前者探索递归数据构造和强化学习如何提升 GUI 智能体，后者则展示主动视觉感知与工具选择在视频理解中的作用。
